findings.passage: This bill serves the public. It paves a way for people to have complaints heard and to gain assurance that our elections are safe and secure.
findings.note: Statement in his official release about a bill he circulated to set a complaint process for federal Help America Vote Act election violations. Related election-integrity material; it does not mention ID or citizenship.

findings.passage: It fulfills the legislative duty for oversight of election integrity, and responds responsibly and urgently to the federal warning, ensuring Wisconsin remains eligible for federal support in maintaining secure and accessible elections.
findings.note: Same release. He describes the bill as the legislature's oversight of election integrity.

findings.passage: Willfully and shamelessly endangering the integrity of Wisconsin’s elections is criminal. It is the responsibility of the Assembly and Senate together to rein in the WEC Administrator and ensure that Wisconsin elections are safe and secure.
findings.note: Statement in his release on a resolution he circulated to impeach the elections commission administrator over unregulated ballot drop boxes. Related election-integrity material; no mention of ID or citizenship.

findings.passage: The sanctity of the ballot box deserves the highest protection and Wolfe failed to give that protection by allowing unregulated drop boxes.
findings.note: Same release. He says the administrator failed to protect the ballot box by allowing drop boxes.
